title: Bug: T2 changes in everflow tests should be applied to all VoQ switches
author: Javier-Tan
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

High

### Description of the bug

We were experiencing everflow failures on new DRH topologies on VoQ switch.

This was caused because: T2 specific changes in everflow tests, specifically TTL adjustments and ECMP next hop skip, should be applied to all VoQ switches (not just T2 VoQ)

### Steps to Reproduce

Run tests on a VoQ switch that does not have a T2 toplogy.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Currently the tests will fail, the test should pass if T2 specific changes are applied to VoQ.
